skill.name: lark-calendar
skill.description: Manage Lark calendar agendas, event creation, attendee lists, free/busy checks, and meeting time suggestions through guided lark-cli workflows.
skill.summary: Guides Lark calendar scheduling, availability checks, and event creation with lark-cli.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown links, inline code, placeholder IDs, and readable Chinese documentation. Cross-directory references to lark-shared are confirmed because they instruct agents to load content outside the audited package, and semantic review found medium-risk issues around external command guidance, attendee edit rights, and long-term memory use.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle required shared guidance inside the skill or declare a marketplace dependency instead of instructing agents to read ../lark-shared paths.

remediation.issue: Broad system command requirement for time conversion
remediation.suggestion: Name safe conversion methods and forbid shell interpolation or arbitrary scripts for user-supplied date strings.
Use least-privilege attendee permissions by default and ask before granting event edit rights to invitees.

remediation.issue: Long-term memory guidance lacks consent controls
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before storing scheduling preferences and document retention and deletion behavior.

# 第二步:添加参会人(使用第一步返回的 calendar_id 和 event_id)
| `--user-id <open_id>` | 否 | 目标查询用户 ID(`ou_` 前缀)。省略时默认查询当前登录用户,bot 身份调用时必须明确指定 |
**CRITICAL — 开始前 MUST 先用 Read 工具读取 [`../lark-shared/SKILL.md`](../lark-shared/SKILL.md),其中包含认证、权限处理*
- **星期的定义**:周一是一周的第一天,周日是一周的最后一天。计算`下周一`等相对日期时,务必基于当前真实日期和星期基准进行推算,避免算错日期。
- **一天的范围**:当用户提到`明天`、`今天`等泛指某一天时,时间范围应默认覆盖整天时间范围。**切勿**自行缩减查询范围,以免遗漏晚上的时间安排。
- **有明确时间点**(如`明早10点`):调用相关工具(如 `lark-cli calendar +freebusy` [lark-calendar-freebusy](references/la
- **有时间区间**(如`明天`、`下午`、`本周`):调用相关工具(如 `lark-cli calendar +suggestion` [lark-calendar-suggestion](ref
- **生活类需求**(如健身、游泳、遛弯、约饭、奶茶等,注意“约咖啡”算工作场景):预期**不调用** `suggestion` 工具。应自行推断合适的非工作时间给到用户确认。如果无法推断,请尝试主
- 待用户确认具体时间选项后,执行 `lark-cli calendar +create --summary "..." --start "..." --end "..." --attendee-id
- **重复规则(Rrule/Recurrence Rule)**:定义重复性日程的重复规则,比如`FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20230307T155959Z;INTERVAL=14`表示每1
Shortcut 是对常用操作的高级封装(`lark-cli calendar +<verb> [flags]`)。有 Shortcut 的操作优先使用。
| [`+agenda`](references/lark-calendar-agenda.md) | 查看日程安排(默认今天) |
| [`+create`](references/lark-calendar-create.md) | 创建日程并邀请参会人(ISO 8601 时间) |
| [`+freebusy`](references/lark-calendar-freebusy.md) | 查询用户主日历的忙闲信息和rsvp的状态 |
| [`+suggestion`](references/lark-calendar-suggestion.md) | 针对时间未确定的预约日程需求,提供多个时间推荐方案 |
在调用 `+suggestion` 之前,务必读取 [lark-calendar-suggestion](references/lark-calendar-suggestion.md) 中的使用说明,
> **重要**:使用原生 API 时,必须先运行 `schema` 查看 `--data` / `--params` 参数结构,不要猜测字段格式。
- `list` — 查询主日历日程忙闲信息

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad System Command Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs agents to use system commands or script code for date and timestamp conversion. Without tighter boundaries, agents may run unnecessary external commands for simple time parsing.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 153 directly mandates external tools for time conversion, but the intent appears to be accuracy rather than malicious execution.

semantic_findings.title: Overly Permissive Event Edit Rights
semantic_findings.description: The create guide says attendees are automatically granted can_modify_event permission. This makes attendee edit rights the default instead of requiring explicit user approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 44 explicitly states that attendees can edit events by default, which is a clear least-privilege concern for calendar writes.

semantic_findings.title: Unbounded Long-Term Preference Storage
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells agents to store attendee disambiguation and personal time-expression preferences in long-term memory. It does not require explicit consent, retention limits, or deletion controls.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly instruct long-term memory creation for scheduling preferences, but implementation depends on the host assistant memory feature.

content.value_statement: Coordinating meetings in Lark is slow when people, time zones, and calendar conflicts are unclear. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Lark calendar commands for agenda review, booking, free/busy checks, and time suggestions.
actual_capabilities: Shows Lark calendar agendas for today or a custom time range.
Creates Lark calendar events with titles, start times, end times, and attendees.
Checks free/busy windows for a Lark user through the calendar CLI.
Suggests meeting slots for attendee lists, time ranges, and meeting durations.
Documents Lark calendar scopes, shortcut commands, and advanced API commands.
limitations: Requires lark-cli, network access, and valid Lark authentication configured outside the skill.
Cannot bypass Lark permissions, tenant policies, or calendar visibility rules.
Meeting room booking is limited to known meeting room IDs.
Advanced API actions may require manual schema review before execution.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Daily Agenda
use_cases.description: Review meetings for the day, group them by date, and identify open time blocks.

use_cases.title: Find a Team Meeting Slot
use_cases.description: Check attendee availability and propose several meeting times before creating an event.

use_cases.title: Create Structured Calendar Events
use_cases.description: Book meetings with clear titles, descriptions, attendees, reminders, and recurrence details.

prompt_templates.title: Show Today Agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Lark calendar agenda for today and summarize any open time blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Book a Simple Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-minute Lark meeting with Alice tomorrow morning. Check availability first and ask me before booking.

prompt_templates.title: Suggest Team Times
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three possible times this week for a 60-minute planning meeting with these Lark attendee IDs: ou_member_a and ou_member_b.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Recurring Sync
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Lark calendar tools to create a recurring project sync with a custom reminder, then verify the attendee list.

output_examples.input: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
output_examples.output: Tomorrow has three meetings. The first starts at 09:00, the longest block is 14:00 to 15:00, and late afternoon is open.

output_examples.input: Find a time with two teammates this afternoon.
output_examples.output: I found three options. The best option is 14:30 to 15:00 because all attendees are free. Please confirm before I book it.

output_examples.input: Create a project review next Thursday at 10:00.
output_examples.output: I can create the project review for next Thursday at 10:00. I will confirm the attendee list and duration before creating the event.

best_practices: Confirm all write actions before creating, updating, or deleting calendar events.
Check free/busy data or suggested slots before booking multi-attendee meetings.
Keep attendee IDs, calendar IDs, time zones, and durations explicit for important meetings.
anti_patterns: Do not create events from vague time ranges without user confirmation.
Do not assume ambiguous people, groups, or meeting rooms when multiple matches exist.
Do not store scheduling preferences without clear user consent.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants work with Lark calendar agendas, event creation, free/busy checks, and meeting time suggestions.

faq.question: Does it require Lark CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is documentation for lark-cli calendar commands and requires valid Lark authentication.

faq.question: Can it create meetings?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide event creation after the user confirms the title, time, duration, and attendees.

faq.question: Can it find free time for a team?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use free/busy and suggestion workflows to propose available meeting slots.

faq.question: Can it book meeting rooms?
faq.answer: Only when a valid meeting room ID is already available in context.

faq.question: Does it bypass calendar permissions?
faq.answer: No. Access is limited by Lark authentication, scopes, tenant policy, and each calendar permission.
